heading: A small team with an outsized impact.
subtext: We are a focused team of strategists, designers, engineers and growth specialists who believe that the best digital products come from people who genuinely care about the outcome.

members.name: Aditya Verma
members.title: Founder and Strategy Lead
members.bio: Aditya started Webvance with one belief, that great digital products begin with a deep understanding of people. He leads strategy and client relationships across every engagement.

members.name: Nisha Raut
members.title: Head of Design
members.bio: Nisha turns complex problems into experiences that feel effortless. She brings a rare combination of visual craft and user psychology to every project she leads.

members.name: Karan Sood
members.title: Lead Engineer
members.bio: Karan architects the technical foundation of everything we build. Performance, scalability and clean code are non-negotiables for him, and it shows in the products we deliver.

members.name: Divya Pillai
members.title: Growth and SEO Specialist
members.bio: Divya connects the dots between audience behaviour and search strategy. She ensures that what we build gets found by the right people at exactly the right moment.
